title: Reasoning Topology Matters: A Controlled Study of LLM-Based Cybersecurity Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2609.24710v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in cybersecurity, where accurate analysis often requires multi-step and context-dependent reasoning over complex and heterogeneous data. However, existing prompting approaches typically focus on eliciting reasoning without explicitly considering how intermediate reasoning steps are structurally organized. We introduce Security Reasoning Topology, which models reasoning through three representative structures: Linear, Branching, and Graph. To evaluate their effects, we conduct controlled experiments on three cybersecurity datasets covering MITRE ATT&CK network traffic, cyber threat intelligence (CTI), and CVE vulnerability analysis. translated_title: 推理拓扑至关重要：基于大语言模型的网络安全分析受控研究
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在网络安全领域的应用日益广泛，而准确的分析往往需要对复杂且异构的数据进行多步骤、依赖上下文的推理。然而，现有的提示方法通常只关注如何引出推理，而没有明确考虑中间推理步骤在结构上是如何组织的。我们提出了安全推理拓扑，通过三种代表性结构对推理进行建模：线性、分支和图结构。为了评估它们的影响，我们在三个网络安全数据集上进行了受控实验，这些数据集涵盖 MITRE ATT&CK 网络流量、网络威胁情报（CTI）和 CVE 漏洞分析。我们评估了多个大语言模型，包括 Llama 2（7B、13B、70B）、GPT-5.1 和 Mistral Large 3，同时保持任务输入一致，并通过系统级提示来控制推理结构。结果表明，推理拓扑显著影响模型的表现。
tldr: 该论文提出“安全推理拓扑”概念，通过线性、分支和图三种推理结构在三个网络安全数据集上进行受控实验，发现中间推理步骤的结构组织方式对大语言模型的网络安全分析性能有显著影响。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Security Reasoning Topology and conducts controlled experiments with Linear, Branching, and Graph reasoning structures across three cybersecurity datasets, showing that the structural organization of intermediate reasoning steps substantially affects LLM performance in cybersecurity analysis.
